fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (ROOFTOP, movedMeters 71) landed directly on the plant building - accurate. Confirmed via Panjiva / Illinois State Fire Marshal records (Caterpillar Engine Systems Inc., 1300 4H Park Rd). The plant has operated since 1978, assembling/testing fuel injectors and fuel pumps for Cat products.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fenced manufacturing facility - chain-link perimeter fence visible around the property in multiple Street Views, with Caterpillar signage and a Caterpillar water tower. A controlled entrance road runs from 4H Park Rd into the property. Set true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively imaged at the gate. Marked guardShack false / remoteGs true on a remote-check-in assumption - low confidence, flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Modest dock activity on the E/NE side: a dock canopy structure with material storage and a few trailers. Estimated ~10 doors, 0-10 band - flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A small trailer/material yard near the E dock area; no large dedicated drop lot - dropArea 0-10, dropYard false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main plant building plus an attached/adjacent cluster of process and utility structures on the SW side (water treatment, support buildings); counted as 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - Pontiac IL is a small town; the plant sits on the edge of town surrounded by farmland with a small residential subdivision adjacent to the N.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~68 acres for the fenced campus including parking, from the perimeter box.
